description: Schéma directeur des Itinéraires cyclables Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Tracé du Schéma Directeur des Itinéraires Cyclables (SDIC) de Nantes Métropole. Le conseil métropolitain a adopté, le 12 février 2021, le nouveau Schéma directeur des itinéraires cyclables de Nantes Métropole. Il dessine la carte du futur réseau vélo métropolitain. Ce jeu de données représente son tracé schématique selon les typologies prévues. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, sdic, mobilité, déplacement, Naolib, mobilité générale. The portal shows 309 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
